//: THE RATCHET. The repo-wide tsconfig runs with checkJs false and noImplicitAny
false, because grading a hundred files nobody wrote types for produces a
number so large it gets ignored. This config grades only the folders that
have been converted, with noImplicitAny ON, and CI runs both.
A folder is added to `include` when its wave lands and never removed. That is
the whole mechanism: strictness arrives one directory at a time, each arrival
is a visible line in a diff, and nothing can quietly regress because the
folder it belongs to is already listed.
`include` NOW COVERS src/**, and every .ts and .tsx in the tree is graded
with noImplicitAny on. What keeps this file alive is checkJs: the 311
remaining .js files are all browser files, they convert with the UI work in
Wave 4, and this config and the allowJs escape hatch go with them.
